Through experience and cunning you know exactly where a strike would be most fatal and how to do it with subtlety.

Once per turn, you can deal extra damage to a target equal to one of your weapon damage types. When attacking with a Light or Finesse weapon, or else a natural weapon, Vital Strike will activate if any of the following is true:

  • You have advantage on the attack. 
  • You are unseen by the target.
  • The target has one or more conditions.

The amount of damage that a Vital Strike deals increases as you gain levels in the Rogue class, as shown in the table below:

*Vital Strike Level is equal to your Rogue level, plus ½ of every non-Rogue level, rounded down. For example, a level 7 Wizard / Level 4 Rogue would have a Vital Strike Level of 7, and could thus deal 4d6 Vital Strike damage.
